intended_behavior: Extend this method to support starting long-running MCP tasks that return a taskId and handle synchronous polling internally until task completion to retrieve the final result, while preserving existing synchronous tool call functionality.

Add new methods to MCPClient to start long-running tasks asynchronously, poll task status by taskId, and fetch task results. These methods should leverage the existing asynchronous background thread infrastructure and delegate to the MCP session communication layer. This will implement support for MCP SEP-1686 long-running tasks, providing a clean and user-friendly API for managing long-running MCP tools.
